The supporting workbook contains 19 conventional and seven climate-adjusted
tables across industries, states and regions. Each observation identifies its
method, industry, geography type and financial-year basis.

Source financial years may use either a shortened end year (`1999-00`) or a
full end year (`1999-2000`). The two labels have the same date contract:
`1999-07-01` through `2000-06-30`. The start is any four-digit year whose
one-year endpoint remains four digits, so `1899-00` and `1899-1900` both map
to `1899-07-01` through `1900-06-30`. Incoherent and malformed simple ranges,
including whitespace or punctuation substitutions around the delimiter,
concatenated years and invalid start-year widths, are rejected with a typed
validation error. The rule is shape-based rather than a list of widths:
numeric runs separated only by punctuation/whitespace and all-digit tokens
longer than four characters fail closed. Named and multi-year summary labels
remain undated.

The 2022–23 to 2024–25 climate adjustment is retained as an interim
methodology regime. Because ABARES republishes revised histories, each annual
workbook is a new vintage rather than an in-place replacement.
